item.title: README
item.description:
Hi, I’m Filip, and this is my README.

I am very excited to be working with you!

You & I

  • 1:1s: Every week we will have a 1:1. During this time I don’t expect project updates, this time is all about you. I will be giving you feedback, asking you for feedback, learning more about your goals, and most importantly - hearing how I can help you become the best you at $COMPANY. If you can’t do your job properly I need to know. If you have thoughts about your career I would love to know too. I’m here to help.
